```{r}
#put this in vpsat
#load libraries
library(tidyverse)

```


```{r}
#read in the data
folder_path <- "/Users/karenzhu/Desktop/Projects/MAIN_structure_project/work/SP001_050/SP020"
CATH_foldseek_search_tbl <- read_tsv(file.path(folder_path, "CATH/CATH_all_vs_all_TM0.5.m8"))
CATH_cluster_tbl <- read.table(file.path(folder_path, "CATH/CATH_easy_cluster_cluster.tsv"), sep = "\t", header = FALSE, col.names = c("representative", "member"))

ECOD_foldseek_search_tbl <- read_tsv(file.path(folder_path, "ECOD/ECOD_all_vs_all_TM0.5.m8"))
ECOD_cluster_tbl <- read.table(file.path(folder_path, "ECOD/ECOD_easy_cluster_cluster.tsv"), sep = "\t", header = FALSE, col.names = c("representative", "member"))

```

```{r}
#plot tcov vs qcov for CATH all-vs-all easy search results
CATH_foldseek_search_tbl %>%
  ggplot() +
  
  geom_point(
    aes(x=qcov, y=tcov),
    alpha = 0.01
  ) +
  
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0.7,
    color="red"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0.7,
    color="red"
  ) +
  labs(title = "CATH Foldseek Search: tcov vs qcov")
```

```{r}
#plot tcov vs qcov for ECOD all-vs-all easy search results
ECOD_foldseek_search_tbl %>%
  ggplot() +
  
  geom_point(
    aes(x=qcov, y=tcov),
    alpha = 0.01
  ) +
  
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0.7,
    color="red"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0.7,
    color="red"
  ) +
  labs(title = "ECOD Foldseek Search: tcov vs qcov")
```

```{r}
#generate a bar graph of the cluster sizes for CATH

#group the representative column and then count the number of representatives

CATH_grouped_cluster_size <- CATH_cluster_tbl %>%
  group_by(representative) %>%
  summarize(cluster_size = n()) 

CATH_grouped_cluster_size_counts <- CATH_grouped_cluster_size %>%
  group_by(cluster_size) %>%
  summarize(n_clusters = n())

#plot the histogram
ggplot(CATH_grouped_cluster_size_counts) +
  
  geom_bar(aes(x = cluster_size, y = n_clusters),
           stat = "identity"
           ) +
  
  labs(title = "CATH foldseek clusters", x = "Cluster size", y = "Number of clusters") +
  theme_minimal()

```
